news.title: Tinubu celebrates Flamingos, U-17 FIFA World Cup winners, says victory, inspiration to youths
news.lede: President Bola Tinubu has congratulated Nigeria’s Flamingos for making history as the first African team to win the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup following their 2-1 victory over Japan in Saturday’s final in Rabat, Morocco. The President, who received the news of the victory upon his return from campaign engagements in Akwa Ibom and Rivers States, hailed Nigeria’s maiden triumph as a proud moment for the nation and a landmark achievement for African women’s football. “What wonderful news to return home to! Our young girls have conquered the world and given Nigerians everywhere another reason to celebrate our great country.

news.title: Nigeria Crowned U17 Women’s World Cup Champions After 2-1 Win Over Japan in Morocco
news.lede: Rabat – Nigeria won the FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026 after defeating Japan 2-1 in the final on Saturday at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Sale. The Nigerian side secured the trophy through goals from Owao Bashiru and Oluyebube Omoijako, while Fuki Ito scored Japan’s only goal. Nigeria took the lead in the 39th minute when Bashiru found the back of the net, giving her team a 1-0 advantage before half-time. The African side maintained its attacking momentum after the break, with Omoijako doubling the lead just two minutes into the second half, putting Nigeria in a strong position to secure the title.
